summary: Startup releases its B12X profiling plans in one batch, so program reclamation and garbage collection run once instead of once per plan
compatibility: No user action required. With a B12X release that has no batched release, plans are released one at a time as before.
details: B12X now reclaims unused programs and runs a full garbage collection after every release call. vLLM released each profiling plan separately, so a start with thousands of plans spent that time once per plan: DeepSeek-V4.1 TP4 and MiMo-V2.6 TP2 did not finish starting within an hour, and GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.8 started minutes later.
The prepared batch now goes to B12X in one release_many call. DeepSeek-V4.1 TP4 starts in about 6 minutes again, with the same KV cache size and decode speed.
